notes.title: Chapter 4 and 5 Released!
notes.content:
Today we are happy to announce that we are releasing the final two remaining chapters for [b]ChuSingura46+1 S[/b]. We have been busy getting it all ready for release since the first DLC was released.

In here we get the new chapters. [b]Revenge blooms, settling old scores[/b] which is the story of Shimizu Ichigaku and the life of Suguha living in Edo. And we also have [b]Of loyalty and heroism[/b] which is the story of Yatou Emoshichi.

We also have a small announcement that we will put the first DLC on sale so if you haven't bought it yet, here is a great opportunity.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/505150/
[b]Bugs:[/b]
Other notes as well. We have mainly been focusing on the new final two chapters but we have revised the older Chapters a little bit to fix some of the misspellings people have found. We also hope the white screen bug should be fixed, we have updated the engine and fixed a few of the errors that might have led to it. We will stay active to see if anyone has any problems with it.

As always, if you find any spelling errors that we might have missed, other bugs that you might find then let us know and we’ll try and fix it as soon as possible.

We hope you all enjoy it very much and we will see you in the discussion boards.

＊DLC 2 is now available for a discounted price.
＊You have to complete chapter 3 in order to unlock chapter 4. So you need to at least have DLC2 to do that.

notes.title: Chapter 4 and 5 news!
notes.content:
We have some new news for all of you that have been asking about the remaining chapters. We are happy to announce that the remaining Chapter 4 & 5 of ChuSingura46+1 S DLC 2 will be released very soon.

We hope that you all can be a little bit more patient until the release of the next chapters that continue the story of Suguha and his other brave Ako Ronins in the Edo era.

On other notes, we are truly thankful for small misspellings etc that you all find. We are doing our best to fix them and will release an update of the game just for that at the same time of this release for all other versions of the game. And we are aware of the white screen problem and we will try and fix it with the release.

If you do find any bugs or errors in the game, please write them in the Discussions board so that we may address them as soon as possible.

We look forward to discussing with you on the forums.

notes.title: Chapter 2 and 3 Released
notes.content:
Thank you all for trying out our visual novel ChuSingura46+1 S. We have been looking through all the discussion posts and reviews to able to better the game, fixings bugs and more. We hope you continue posting any bugs that might happen during your travels in the Edo period so that we can sit down and fix as many of them as we can.

Today we are releasing our first Dlc which is the second chapter “Edo radicals” and the third chapter “Harbinger of spring” of the game. It will further continue the story of Fukami Suguha and his adventures during the Edo period in Japan.

We hope you all like it very much and we’ll see you in the discussion boards.

＊Update1
We had a small problem with releasing the DLC and we are now happy to say that we have fixed it. Now everyone can purchase it wether or not you own the main game "ChuSingura46+1 S"

＊Update2
We are currently fixing issues that people are experiencing. So wait a little bit more for an update. Also if you successfully bought the DLC but don't get the DLC downloading file. Check the games property window for the DLC1 or check inside the Library on your game if it has the DLC window.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25419201/5a7878cd33ca6f784d5df33cdbdf0b196b292487.png[/img]

＊Update3
We just put up a patch for you guys, It fixes some of the missing files, CG Mode, and Chapter 2 errors. Hopefully it works a lot better by now.

notes.title: Chapter 2 and 3 news!
notes.content:
We would like to thank all of you that downloaded the first chapter and played it. We have been reading your reviews and discussions in order to fix any problems that may have occurred during your play-through. We did release a patch which fixed many of the bugs that kept appearing and hopefully it smoothens out the experience for you all.

And to the main announcement. We have some new information for you all that have been waiting for more information about the game. We are happy to announce that at the end of July we are going to release Chapter 2 and 3 as a set for sale as DLC. This will further on continue the story of Suguha and his experience in the ChuSingura46+1 S world.

Please wait a little bit more for the continuation of the story about the 46+1 brave samurais.

If you do find any bugs or errors in the game, please write them in the Discussions board so that we may address them as soon as possible.

We look forward to discussing with you on the forums.

notes.title: ChuSingura46+1 S is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone and thank you.

We would like to thank you for testing out the game and giving us a lot feedback. We will look over all the conversations and improve as much as possible of the game.
And we also have a few clarifications that we've read on the discussions board and other places as well.

This version of the game is the first chapter that is a free to play demo version of the game. We hope you enjoy it and if you find any bugs or any other problems with the game. Please write in the Discussions board and we will try fix as many problems as possible and patch it.
Also regarding this game version. It is a non hentai/sex scene version of the game and will remain so as well. Were sorry to disappointing some fans on this matter.
We have also seen a few messages regarding "what does the 'S' stand for in the title?" In a previous Vita version of the game the title was "ChuSingura46+1 V" so we named this game with an S because this is the Steam version of the game.

As we said before that this games first Chapter is indeed for free and in the future we will release more chapters so stay tuned. More information regarding this will come at a later time.

We look forward to discussing with you on the forums.
